name: photo-library
description: Photo Library Flask web application (Python bundle). Data and storage can live outside the installed package.

common-all.notes: Source-only Python bundle; first start installs requirements with pip into bundle-local vendor/pyX.Y. Requires Python, pip and initial network access.

photo-library.description: Run Photo Library via Client Python

modules.name: photo-library-web
modules.description: Runs Photo Library with configurable HTTP bind and optional persistent data/storage roots. Clear either directory field to use the original project-local directory.

params.name: instance_name
params.label: Instance Name
params.description: Unique instance name (use separate data/storage locations for separate instances).

params.name: address
params.label: Listen Address
params.description: 127.0.0.1 for local use; 0.0.0.0 exposes the web service to the LAN (secure it before doing so).

params.name: port
params.label: Listen Port
params.description: HTTP server port; must be free on the Client machine.

params.name: data_dir
params.label: Data Directory (optional)
params.description: Existing Client-side directory for photo_library.db, custom_helpers.py and final_metadata_settings.json. Clear to use the bundled project/data directory.

params.name: storage_dir
params.label: Storage Directory (optional)
params.description: Existing Client-side storage root (uploads, thumbnails, compressed, library_cache). Clear to use bundled project/storage.
